name: Satfera Samuhlagna (DCW) Scheme
benefit: **Monetary Incentive to Couples:** - ₹12,000 is provided to each newly married couple from socially and educationally backward classes and economically backward classes. **Support to Organizing Institutions:** - ₹3,000 per couple is granted to the organizing institution, up to a maximum of ₹75,000 per event.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a newly married female. 1. The applicant should belong to a Socially and Educationally Backward Class (SEBC) or Economically Backward Class. 1. The applicant’s annual individual income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
